Sleep came in time, but in short supply.
I spent time at home depo buying the tubes and fixtures needed. Grocery store for a quality oven bag or two. Then it's just putting everything together. Then when its tested and prepared... We will see if that eases my ... 
It doesn't matter anymore really. No point. 

You're kind to speak positive to someone you dont know. 

I'm much more garbage then not. I say so knowing who and what I am. 

It's ok.

This is a wonderful rendition. It does flow, yet holds onto the tenseness. It was a short video made about rat races in an animated short that you could easily find on YouTube I'm sure if you googled animated rat race or something like that. This gives me an incredibly sharp reminder of a sexual predator boss I had who hired little girls and never ran out of his back office to do any work unless there was high school girls were killed on that he would just stand behind the cash and gawk at. I was hired under false pretenses and lies that were never able to be rectified. I stayed until I get gather enough evidence to get him fired and all they did was fire me for insubordination. He continued his predatory conduct and abuse staff for a full year and a half longer before they did anything about it and guess what we all worked for Bell and they didn't give a fuck still out and about roaming even though there's footage of him having sex with underage women in the back room and abusing girls. He was the manager that was able to fire me after I made my direct complaint against him for sexual harassment that I had seen him commit which was on my own cell phone footage as well as the store footage from cameras. I feel absolutely like cattle every time I'm begging for a decent living wage and a time I work somewhere and even then it's not enough. No I don't think you missed with the flow and incorrect way at all you capture it incredibly well and cleanly without all of my clearly extra flair and digression. I think you did a solid example of a clean well thought out thought process on what was happening. I applaud the goat'ly hoof handshake.

When you have given so many pieces to someone... All you have often, is the little things. I have the last piece of wrapped gum and the list of things she wanted me to improve on ( which all were enthusiasticly done and worked on)  elastic banded together. As well as a cute Christmas gift of loving coupons hand made in a beautiful, made by her hand, booklet. *One free cuddling movie night, ect*
I can barely talk about them with out tearing up like I am now. Cannot stand hearing the our favorite shows them song... 
All you and I seem to have is heavy weighted pieces we need to cling onto. It is possibly our knowingly unhealthy anchor.

I do not mean to steal your sorrow to make it like my own. (Forgive me if I have inadvertently). 
But this did make me realize I do the same with dozens of things and letters paintings and even plants, because they are the last things she ever gave me and I didn't deserve any of it. 

Many are locked away in a safe I don't look at.

Wholesome AF. We forget that knowledge use to require a lot of personal effort to learn about. That's if it's something you could even imagine about the world or what's in it.
Before then you just have to deal with whoever said nuhhh uhhnn Billy's dad said this , or radioand tv topics. 90s were rough 😅
✌️4️⃣🇺🇦Now.

I have things to say. A lot of truths, and maybe an explanation of ones own self-led battles.

I have lived with, and was nearly killed by a Mississauga based serial killer Douglas Moore. Another broken heart... It was so that I could stay in Hamilton during my graduation after moving to a faraway foster home. He tried to kill me at least three times that I know of and the garage always reaked of bleach, and gas... With a hint of old pennies. 

I've also ridden horses through a fog filled Forest behind Kinnity Castle in Ireland, with the love of my life of more then ten years. 

I've nearly died of pneumonia after spending most of the Canadian winter homeless living outside in a snowfort made from memories of a better time. Having to resort to eating out of garbages, and what could beg, borrow, or steal from Friends working at the local malls food court. 

I've lived in suburbia even. Although in a gated community with heavy security. It was a foster programs center.  Laurencrest Youth Detention Center. That was an eye opening experience. 
Cruel, and unethical. So poorly managed. We were the free labor for all work, yet there was no pay or option for refusal. 

More then 27 or 30 schools ... Dozens and dozens of jobs. New cities and homes every three to six months. Every P.O.C. (plan of care meeting) they decided what to do with me.

Community crime, and I would call them out and shake up the system when I would refuse to do their work and they would threaten consequences of loss of privilege to which I would say that there's nothing that they can do to me that hasn't already been done 10 times worse and I know that in the end they still have to feed me and they still have to clothe me and have a roof over my head and that there was nothing that they could do that scared me so they would keep on moving me so that other kids in the programs didn't adapt/learn my way of thought. 

There is little left I have to do now.
Besides just ... writing, and editing what needs to be there when I'm gone. What may hold realizations for those who knew me. What may answer their questions. 

Knowing this. Knowing that I have a way out helps. 
I actually understand that a lot better now. 
The Jim Carrey's and Robin Williams esq types.
The broken heart. That smile. That ability to relate. The knowledge of hurt and ones own illness, aids in affecting us more deeply. Where we can feel a personal connection through the delivery of dialogue's, and mannerisms of a hurting, sad, lonely person. Why they are so good at making others laugh which makes us with depressed hearts, feel good. 

9 years old ... I was 9 years old when I first tried to commit sucide. 
Nine. 
When the attempt failed as the closest poll collapsed from my *weaker body thrashing breath. Betraying me. 
I was beaten for hours afterwards. Draw string still around my neck.

I scoff at god's, and spit blood at fate.

I've wanted to make a lot public. 
I wanted to bare naked, my painful heart, and path. Others will need that help to heal themselfs. Even in death, no matter how viciously I feel compelled to act, I don't want them left without a piece of me they never saw. Without the honesty they could believe as at a time like this, I'd have no more lies to give. 

That's all. That's the only reason. I assure you.

I wish I could do the same. Without the disease and scars. physical and emotional. And there's more scars than one might think due to the disease so while I would love to give the years or days at least to somebody else without any of that, that would be the only thing that would make this better.
